title: window_headMPD skin sidecar
description: Per-skin data the engine never reads out of the archive (ENGINE.md D10.6). One file per skin, named <sha256 of the archive>.json under src/app/sidecars/. src/app/sidecar.js validates every sidecar against this file before the engine sees it. Only the keywords sidecar.js implements are used here (a test walks this file and fails on any other): $ref to #/$defs, type, const, enum, properties, additionalProperties, required, propertyNames, items, minItems, maxItems, minLength, maxLength, pattern, minimum, maximum. A key this file does not name is rejected, at every level.

skin.description: SHA-256 of the archive this sidecar belongs to, lower-case hex. Must equal the file name.

overlays.description: Trusted TEXT elements appended under a VIEW or SUBVIEW after the literal pass (the Headspace EQ frequency labels, parity D1).

attrs.description: Attributes the host sets after layout under origin 'sidecar', in every configuration: x- host-only switches, and the ordinary attributes of a host-drawn control the skin leaves at the WMP defaults (the Headspace PLAYLIST colours). Applied in file order, before compat.attrs.

compat.description: Applies only under the oracle-compat configuration, after attrs: attributes that reproduce a slip of the hand port the faithful engine does not repeat.

actions.description: What the host does for skin calls it must define itself.

restore.description: Drawer state the shell persists and replays (parity D23): after every dispatch it reads each global and stores changes under pref in the app namespace; after onload it calls each toggle whose pref is true.

viewResize.description: 'ignore' keeps the window size when the skin writes view.width or view.height (parity D13).

ref.description: An element id: a declared id or Unnamed_<kind>_<n>. Any non-empty string without control characters; __proto__ and constructor are ordinary refs.

identifier.description: A script global: a variable or function name.

attrs.description: Literal attribute values of the TEXT element, by attribute name.

hostStyle.description: CSS the WMS has no attribute for. letterSpacing is the only key allowed.

attr.description: One attribute write on the element named by ref: an attribute of the element's kind in the WMS table, or an x- host-only one (which the element model accepts from a sidecar and from nothing else). The value is coerced by the attribute's type, so a colour is written as #RRGGBB.

tour.description: What the Headspace demo choreography (src/app/demo/headspace.js) needs to find its way around the skin: element refs, the two mapping colours of the transport group, script names, and the cursor's resting point in view px. Nothing in the engine reads it.

bands.description: The ten equalizer sliders, lowest band first (left to right).

rest.description: Where the cursor waits, in view px.
